section.materialRules: [Material] Components/consumables only. Not reimbursable: books, reagents, printing, office supplies, computer accessories. Dev boards over ¥1000 are not allowed. Upload purchase lists for vague invoices.
section.travelRules: [Travel] Upload flight itineraries, rail e-tickets, hotel invoices, etc. Long-distance transport is capped at the Chengdu-to-venue second-class high-speed rail fare; excess is self-paid. Upload hotel folios when room/night details are missing. Explain one-way or mismatched round trips in remarks.

form.remarkOptionalNoTemplate: Optional. Material claims for this business category do not use the competition remark template.
form.remarkHint: Fill in each item below to help teachers review and enter data into the finance system.
form.remarkSelectCategoryHint: Select an expense category first to show the matching remark template.
form.remarkGuideMaterial: Include: team ID; team member names and student IDs; stage and awards; school competition participation; school award (for sponsor subsidy); purpose.
form.remarkGuideTravel: Include: team ID; competition stage and awards; team member names and student IDs; origin and destination; travel dates; expense summary. Transport: even if you claim one-way fare only, you must submit round-trip rail or flight tickets with invoices so the trip is closed-loop; otherwise finance will reject. Explain if one-way only or routes do not match.
form.remarkGuideTravelIot: Include: team ID; competition stage (semifinal/final); awards; team member names and student IDs; origin and destination; travel dates; expense summary. Transport: even if you claim one-way fare only, you must submit round-trip rail or flight tickets with invoices so the trip is closed-loop; otherwise finance will reject. Explain if one-way only or routes do not match.

Materials: If invoice item names are generic (e.g. components, batch, set) or lack specific names/quantities, a stamped official purchase list is required; if unavailable, Taobao order screenshots may be uploaded as supporting detail.
Server rental: A formal expense breakdown or an invoice with itemized charges is required.
Travel: For hotel invoices that do not state the number of rooms and nights, a hotel folio must be uploaded as additional supporting documentation.
Travel: For taxi/ride-hailing expenses, a trip itinerary must be uploaded.
item.issuerPayeeInconsistent:
If the invoice issuer and payee differ, check this box and upload an explanation (see "View template").
Travel note: For hotel invoices where the issuer does not match the payee on your booking app payment record, upload a hotel-issued letter explaining the relationship between the invoice issuer and the hotel.
